name: Sarah & David Jenkins
title: A perfect weekend coastal escape
content: We spent two nights in the Harbour Room. Waking up to the sea air, having a proper hearty breakfast, and settling in front of the log fire with a pint of local ale after walking Hurlstone Point made this our favourite pub stay in the West Country.

name: Mark Thornton
title: Superb Saturday BBQ and real ales
content: The Saturday braai was fantastic! Fresh grilled local seafood, friendly team behind the bar, and cold pints looking directly out over Porlock Weir harbour. Can't wait to return.

name: Emma W.
title: Dog-friendly and exceptionally welcoming
content: So rare to find a truly historic pub that genuinely welcomes dogs by the open fire. The staff brought over a water bowl and dog treats straight away. Delicious Sunday roast too!
